무엇을: BUSD는 2023년 초 발행사 Paxos가 뉴욕 금융감독청(NYDFS) 지시로 신규 발행을 멈춤. FDUSD(First Digital Labs, 홍콩)가 2023-06 출시돼 Binance 주요 거래쌍과 Earn 자산으로 그 자리를 채움
원문 근거 문장: FDUSD gained prominence as one of the stablecoins that filled the gap left by BUSD after Paxos halted new BUSD minting in early 2023 under regulatory direction from the New York Department of Financial Services. Binance, as the largest exchange in the crypto ecosystem, adopted FDUSD as a core trading pair and earn-product asset, driving rapid early adoption.
